labels.PHONETIC_ALIGNED: raw Mantel > 95th pct of scramble null (p<0.05) AND partial-Mantel r(T,P|C) CI lower bound > 0, under BOTH T-encodings AND BOTH P-distances. The only positive; the only verdict that licenses B1/B2.
labels.PHONETICS_ONLY: raw Mantel beats scramble null but partial-Mantel collapses (CI includes 0): alignment is entirely the varga place/manner grid. A NEGATIVE for the table (expected default).
labels.TABLE_NULL: raw Mantel <= scramble median: no better than randomly relabeled tables. A clean negative.
labels.ENCODING_DEPENDENT: passes under one T-encoding or P-distance but not the other: non-confirmation, not a partial win.
labels.INCONCLUSIVE: ambiguous scramble percentile, or partial-Mantel CI spans 0 with wide bounds (low power from 34 items).

interpretation_guards.no_raw_without_partial: Raw Mantel is NEVER reported as a result without the partial-Mantel C-control.
interpretation_guards.phonetics_only_is_negative: PHONETICS_ONLY and ENCODING_DEPENDENT are negatives, never relabeled as partial successes.
interpretation_guards.scope: A verdict is about the representation's phonetic grounding ONLY — not perception, not ontology, not Symbol-U.
interpretation_guards.verdict_authority: Verdict set solely by the primary T_embed under both encodings with the mandatory partial-Mantel; the categorical T_cat is sensitivity only.
